_comment: OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023) mapped to Blitz Strike coverage. Each risk has its id, name, and the Blitz technique/tool that hunts it.

risks.name: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
risks.desc: Accessing another user's object by tampering the object id without an authorization check.

risks.name: Broken Authentication
risks.desc: Weak or bypassable authentication (JWT, OAuth, token, credential flaws).

risks.name: Broken Object Property Level Authorization (BOPLA)
risks.desc: Mass assignment / excessive data exposure of object properties.

risks.name: Unrestricted Resource Consumption
risks.desc: DoS via missing rate limits, deep recursion, or resource exhaustion.

risks.name: Broken Function Level Authorization (BFLA)
risks.desc: Invoking admin-only functions without the right role.

risks.name: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
risks.desc: Abusing a legitimate business flow (purchase, redeem) without authorization.

risks.name: Server Side Request Forgery
risks.desc: The API fetches an attacker-influenced URL to reach internal services.

risks.name: Security Misconfiguration
risks.desc: Verbose errors, exposed debug/admin endpoints, missing headers, CORS misconfig.

risks.name: Improper Inventory Management
risks.desc: Orphaned/legacy API versions or endpoints left undocumented and unprotected.

risks.name: Unsafe Consumption of APIs
risks.desc: Trusting third-party API responses that are then processed unsafely.
